QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says user code gets `private_*` names when the macro is undefined and plain names when defined, and names who defines it (library, programs), but it never states the two-views point in those terms. It does say users who define the gate macro get direct access, and the library's inline accessors resolve to `private_*` names in user code. Even so, it doesn't frame the two branches as giving different consumers different views, so the item resolves to MISS.
